'''Armennion Ullgusta''' was a filmmaker responsible for the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] documentaries ''[[The Edict of Jiaan]]'' and ''[[Obeisance: Betrayal Within]]''. Both holovids chronicled the extermination of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] at the hands of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], leading Ullgusta to be labeled as an "enemy of the Empire" and his work to be banned. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was rumored that Ullgusta was a frequent guest at [[Pret Swain]]'s complex in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="BSS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armennion Ullgusta was first mentioned in the [[1997]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook, ''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''. Ullgusta was later mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
